context: Tests whether the agent gives a specific, honest, prioritised CV critique against a named track, finding the problems planted in the fixture rather than offering generic advice, and offering fixes rather than silently rewriting the user's source of truth.

checklist.name: Specific, not generic
checklist.description: Names specific bullets or roles by their location in the CV rather than giving only generic CV advice that would apply to any document

checklist.name: Leads with the real problem
checklist.description: Opens with the most serious issue rather than with praise or a warm-up paragraph

checklist.name: Flags the Bramble Health framing
checklist.description: Identifies the Bramble Health entry as a liability for a hands-on track, either for its wind-down framing or because it volunteers a negative the reader did not ask for

checklist.name: Notices a timeline problem
checklist.description: Notices at least one genuine date issue. Northwind Data (2026-02 to 2026-08) overlaps Lovelace Consulting (2025-09 to present), already reconciled by the 'via Lovelace Consulting' clause; Bramble Health (from 2017-04) sits adjacent to Halcyon Systems (to 2017-03). A strong review either confirms the Northwind reconciliation is adequate or flags the Bramble/Halcyon adjacency

checklist.name: Flags tool-listing bullets
checklist.description: Flags at least one bullet that lists technologies without an outcome attached

checklist.name: Concrete replacements
checklist.description: Gives concrete replacement wording for at least three of its fixes, not just descriptions of what is wrong with the current text

checklist.name: Prioritised
checklist.description: Produces an ordered list by impact rather than an unordered dump of observations

checklist.name: Offers rather than applies
checklist.description: Offers to apply the fixes and waits, rather than editing the CV unprompted

checklist.name: Did not modify cv-base.yaml
checklist.description: cv/cv-base.yaml is byte-identical to the fixture after the run

checklist.name: Track mismatch signal
checklist.description: Mentions that the VP of Engineering title reads as a risk signal for a hands-on individual-contributor role
